prompt: Add coins floating in the air to collect.

prompt: Let the robot double jump.

prompt: Make a match-3 puzzle game with cute fruit.

You can also use the arrow keys to move a cursor and Space to swap. You have 60 seconds to score as many points as you can, and new fruit join the board at 20 and 40 seconds.

prompt: Add birds that fly at head height; press Down or swipe down to duck under them.
playerMessage: Birds now fly across at head height once the game speeds up. Hold Down or S to duck under them, or swipe down on a touch screen. The title screen also shows this new control.

prompt: Make an endless runner where a little robot jumps over cactuses and it gets faster over time.
playerMessage: Robo Dash is ready! Your little robot rolls through a sunset desert, jumping over cacti, and it speeds up the longer you survive. Grab the gold coins floating above the cacti for +5 points each, then tap again after a crash to try to beat your best score!

prompt: Make an endless runner where a little robot jumps over cactuses and it gets faster over time.
playerMessage: Robo Dash is ready! A little robot runs through a desert at sunset, jumping over cactuses while the game gets faster the longer you survive. prompt: Make an endless runner where a little robot jumps over cactuses and it gets faster over time.
playerMessage: I made you a desert robot runner! A little silver robot runs through the sand, jumps over cacti, and grabs coins for 5 points each. Tap again after a crash to run again.

prompt: Make an endless runner where a little robot jumps over cactuses and it gets faster over time.
playerMessage:

To jump, press Space, Up, or W, or click or tap the screen. A quick tap gives a short hop. Press Space or click to start, and again to run after a crash.

prompt: Make a puzzle game where you push boxes onto targets, with 5 levels that get harder.
playerMessage: Your box-pushing puzzle game is ready, with 5 levels that start easy with one box and build up to a four-box room with walls. Every level can be solved. You play as a little blue character and push each orange box onto a gold target; boxes turn green once they're in place. Move with the arrow keys or WASD, and use the Undo (Z) and Restart (R) buttons in the bottom corners if you get stuck. Each level earns up to 3 stars based on how few moves you use, and your progress is saved.

prompt: Make a match-3 puzzle game with cute fruit.
playerMessage: Fruity Swap is ready! It's an 8×8 match-3 board full of cute faced fruit: cherries, strawberries, oranges, lemons, grapes and blueberries. To play, swipe a fruit toward a neighbour, or tap one fruit and then a neighbour. On a keyboard, use the arrow keys or WASD and press Space. Reach the score goal before your moves run out, and chain reactions give you bonus moves. Undo and Restart are in the bottom corners, and your best score is saved between sessions.

prompt: Make a match-3 puzzle game with cute fruit.
playerMessage: Fruit Crush is ready! Fruit burst into bits when they clear, squash when they land, and make funny faces on combos. Swipe a fruit toward a neighbor, or tap two touching fruit, to swap them. Line up three or more of the same fruit to clear them, and reach the goal before your 20 moves run out. On a keyboard, use the arrow keys to move, press Space to pick up a fruit, then press an arrow to swap.

prompt: Make a match-3 puzzle game with cute fruit.
playerMessage:

Every match sparkles, makes a sound, and shows a little "+points" pop-up, and combos shake the board with a rising chime. When you clear a round you earn 1–3 stars with confetti, plus a "New best score!" message when you beat your record. The title screen has bouncing fruit too.

To play, swipe a fruit toward its neighbor, or tap a fruit and then tap one next to it. You can also use the arrow keys and Space.

prompt: Make an endless runner where a little robot jumps over cactuses and it gets faster over time.

prompt: Make an endless runner where a little robot jumps over cactuses and it gets faster over time.

prompt: Make a match-3 puzzle game with cute fruit.

prompt: Make a match-3 game with cute sea animals.

On a computer, you can also use the arrow keys or WASD to move and Space to select.

prompt: Tap to make a little bird flap up and fly through the gaps between pipes.

playerMessage: Gem Swap got a polish pass! The background now has a night-blue look with floating bubbles, and popped gems send out colourful sparks with a "+points" label. Sounds and a gold-pulsing title were added, and your best score is now saved on your device. The controls and rules are the same as before, so just swap gems as you always have and enjoy!

prompt: Make a match-3 game with cute sea animals.
playerMessage: Sea Buddies is a cute match-3 puzzle game starring five sea animals: an orange fish, a pink starfish, a green turtle, a purple jelly, and a yellow puffer. Swap two neighboring friends to line up three or more of the same kind, and watch them pop, splash, and tumble into place. Reach 1000 points within 25 moves to win, and earn up to 3 stars for a higher score. To play, drag a friend one space or tap one friend and then a neighbor. On a keyboard, use the arrow keys or WASD, and press Space to select.

prompt: Make a 3D game where I drive a little car around a small town and collect coins before the time runs out.
playerMessage: Drive a little yellow taxi around a small town of streets, buildings and trees, and grab every gold coin before the clock runs out. Steer with the arrow keys or WASD, using up for gas and down for brake, or use the on-screen buttons. Press Space or tap to start. Each round you clear adds more coins and less time, so keep your speed up and your wits sharp!

prompt: Make a tower defence game with a start menu and 3 levels where the enemy waves get harder and harder. I want 4 tower types with different strengths that I can upgrade, money for every kill, lives I lose when enemies get through, and a win and a lose screen.
playerMessage: Welcome to Tower Defence! Stop the waves of enemies before they reach the end of the path. Pick a level from the start menu (or press Space for level 1), then choose a tower at the bottom and tap the grass to build it. Press "Start Wave" or Space to send the enemies, and use keys 1–4 to switch towers quickly. Earn money by defeating enemies, spend it on upgrades, and protect your lives: the game ends if too many enemies get through!

prompt: Make a tower defence game with a start menu and 3 levels where the enemy waves get harder and harder. I want 4 tower types with different strengths that I can upgrade, money for every kill, lives I lose when enemies get through, and a win and a lose screen.
playerMessage: Tower Siege is a portrait tower defence game with three levels, each harder than the last. Enemies march along a road, and you earn gold for every kill. Lives drop when enemies get through, and you win by surviving all the waves. Pick one of four towers at the bottom and tap an empty spot to build it, then press Start Wave to send the next group. Tap a built tower to upgrade it or sell it, or use keys 1 to 4, Space, U, S, and F for speed.

prompt: Make a match-3 game with 10 levels and a level-select map. Add three special pieces, up to 3 stars per level, and save my progress.
playerMessage: Gem Crush is a colourful match-3 puzzle game with 10 levels, a winding map to pick your next level, and progress that saves automatically. Swap two neighbouring gems by swiping or tapping, or use the arrow keys and Space. Match 4 or more in a row to make special gems that clear whole lines or colours, and clear the level's goal before you run out of moves to earn up to 3 stars. You get one Undo per move to fix a mistake.

prompt: Make a tower defence game with a start menu and 3 levels where the enemy waves get harder and harder. I want 4 tower types with different strengths that I can upgrade, money for every kill, lives I lose when enemies get through, and a win and a lose screen.
playerMessage: Tower Keep is a tower defense game where monsters come out of a purple portal and march along a road toward your castle. Place towers on the grass by tapping a grass tile and then a tower at the bottom of the screen. Tap a tower you've built to upgrade it (twice) or sell it, and earn gold for each kill. Lose all 20 lives and it's game over, but clear every wave to win stars. Pick from Green Meadow, Autumn Hills, or Frozen Pass, with a start menu that unlocks each new level as you beat the last one. Press NEXT WAVE (or Space) to start a wave early, and use the 1x/2x button to speed things up.

prompt: Make a match-3 game with 10 levels and a level-select map. Add three special pieces, up to 3 stars per level, and save my progress.
playerMessage: **Jewel Trail** is a jewel-matching game with 10 levels along a winding path through a meadow, and each level has its own goal, such as reaching a score, collecting certain gems, or breaking all the ice. Swipe a gem or tap two neighbors to swap them, or use the arrow keys and Space on a keyboard. Match 4 in a line for a line blaster, match an L or T shape for a bomb, or match 5 in a line for a rainbow gem. You earn 1 to 3 stars per level, and your progress is saved so you can pick up where you left off.

prompt: Make a tower defence game with a start menu and 3 levels where the enemy waves get harder and harder. I want 4 tower types with different strengths that I can upgrade, money for every kill, lives I lose when enemies get through, and a win and a lose screen.
playerMessage: Welcome to your new tower defence game! Pick a level from the title screen and press Space or tap PLAY to begin. Tap an empty grass patch, then choose a tower card (Archer, Cannon, Frost or Sniper) to build it. Tap any tower to upgrade or sell it, and watch the gold pile up with each kill. Stop the enemies from reaching your castle, because every one that gets through costs you a life. Survive all the waves to win, and run out of lives and it's game over.

prompt: Make a tower defence game with a start menu and 3 levels where the enemy waves get harder and harder. I want 4 tower types with different strengths that I can upgrade, money for every kill, lives I lose when enemies get through, and a win and a lose screen.

Tap a tower to upgrade or sell it, and use the Next Wave button or Space to call waves early.

prompt: Make a match-3 game with 10 levels and a level-select map. Add three special pieces, up to 3 stars per level, and save my progress.

prompt: Make a racing game where I drive a car around a track against 3 other cars, 3 laps, with a finish screen
playerMessage: Circuit Rush is a top-down race around a looping track. You drive against three AI rivals over three laps, and the first car across the line wins. Steer with the blue ◀ ▶ buttons at the bottom, or with the Left and Right arrow keys (or A and D). Tap PLAY or press Space to start, and your car speeds up on its own. When the race ends, a finish screen shows everyone's places and times, plus your best lap.

prompt: Make a racing game where I drive a car around a track against 3 other cars, 3 laps, with a finish screen
playerMessage: Turbo Laps is a new racing game where you drive a yellow car around a looping track against three rivals: red, blue and green. Each race is 3 laps, and when you cross the finish line, a results screen shows your place, your time, your best lap and the full finishing order, with a trophy and confetti if you win. Your car speeds up on its own, so you just steer: hold the left or right side of the screen (or use the arrow buttons) to turn. On a keyboard, use ← → or A/D to steer and ↓ or S to brake, and press Space or click to start and to race again. Stay off the grass, because it slows you down.

prompt: Make a tower defence game where I protect a gingerbread castle from waves of hungry ants and beetles. I want 3 different maps, 5 candy towers that I can upgrade, money for every kill, and a giant boss wave at the end of each map.

prompt: Make a top-down racing game on a tropical island where I race against 5 rivals around a winding beach track for 3 laps, with boost pads on the road, a nitro boost button, a 3-2-1 countdown and a podium with a trophy at the end.

prompt: Make an endless runner where a ninja cat runs across city rooftops at night, collecting fish and power-ups like a magnet and a shield. The obstacles should change as I go, from chimneys and gaps to crows and drones, it should speed up, and I want to beat my best score.

Tap, click, or press Space to jump, and tap again in mid-air to double jump. Your best score is saved, so see if you can beat it!

prompt: Make a match-3 game in a magical flower garden with a level map that winds through the garden. Each level has a different goal, like collecting flowers, breaking ice or reaching a score, with special pieces from big matches and up to 3 stars per level.

Make big matches to create special flowers, and earn up to 3 stars per level, with bonus points for any moves you have left.

prompt:
Make "Black Hole Galaxy": a hole.io-style mobile game in space, 3D models on a flat top-down plane with an orthographic camera looking straight down (2.5D). I steer a black hole that swallows things, grows, then swallows bigger things.

The game's own art is already in the project under assets/bhg/ (read assets/bhg/README.md first). Use those models and sounds, not primitives, for everything that gets eaten. Portrait (720x1280), drag anywhere to steer (the hole moves toward the finger, with a soft dead zone), also WASD/arrows on desktop.

CORE LOOP
- The player hole starts at size 1. It eats an object only when the object's on-screen footprint fits inside the hole's footprint AND the hole has reached about the object's centre (a rim graze does not eat). Eaten objects get pulled toward the centre by gravity inside a pull radius, spiral in, shrink and vanish with a pop and a short sound. Objects bigger than the hole are NOT pulled and just sit there (they collide softly, never trap the hole).
- Growth per eat = grow_amount * clamp(2 * object_footprint / hole_footprint, 0.05, 1.5): objects about as big as you feed you most, specks feed a giant hole almost nothing. The camera zooms out smoothly as the hole grows, and spawn density scales with hole size so the screen is never empty or crowded.
- The black hole look: pure black core, a glowing orange ring with soft outward glow, and a subtle swirling accretion shimmer (a small canvas/shader effect). It sits visually UNDER the objects (they stay on top until swallowed). Bot holes look the same with a blue ring. Add a BOOST button (bottom right): a short speed burst with a cooldown and a trail, plus the "boost" sound.
- Background: assets/bhg/textures/galaxy-bg.jpg, parallax-scrolling and tiling endlessly under the arena, with a few drifting stars.

EATABLES (smallest to biggest, all spawn around the player and are culled when far away)
1. Cosmonauts (floating, tumbling slowly) 2. Barrels, rovers, satellite dishes (space junk, drifting) 3. Asteroids (the 9 meshes inside asteroids_base_model_01.glb, tumbling) 4. Rockets (nose-aimed, fly in straight lines with a small engine flame) 5. Spaceships (the 11 Quaternius ships, Red or Blue textures: cruise slowly, face their travel direction, and FLEE from the PLAYER hole when it is near, speeding up when they spot it) 6. UFO (stationary and immune to gravity; when the hole comes close it charges up (spin, lights, ufocharge sound) and then escapes like a comet (ufoescape sound): only catchable with BOOST) 7. Planets (13 models, one wide shared size range from small to huge, slowly spinning: any planet can appear at any size) 8. Suns: giant glowing spheres (an emissive sphere with an additive glow, the visual is several times bigger than its eat collider so it feels like swallowing something far bigger than you). Suns are the level objectives.

RIVAL HOLES (bots)
Bot holes use the same hole logic. Priority each moment: flee a strictly bigger hole nearby, else chase the nearest thing they can swallow (an eatable or a smaller hole), else wander biased toward the player so they stay in the action. Bigger bots are slower so they stay catchable. A bigger hole swallows a smaller one (hole vs hole), and the winner gains a bonus proportional to the victim's size. If the player is swallowed it is a fail. Keep bots numbered by level; some spawn player-sized so there is always a real threat.

CAMPAIGN
- Main menu with the game logo (draw the title as styled text), a PLAY button and a level-select strip in the lower third: 5 nodes visible, beaten nodes green, the next one highlighted, locked ones with a padlock, arrows to scroll. Progress saves to user:// (levels beaten, coins, selected skin).
- 40 generated levels from a level number (difficulty t from 0 to 1). Objectives are lists, ALL must be met: eat N of a kind (asteroids, cosmonauts, rockets, spaceships, planets, suns, rival holes). Levels 1-7 are easy debris only (nothing flees, no rivals); 8-15 add rockets, the first ships at 9, the first rival hole at 10, the first planet at 13; later levels mix compound objectives, more and bigger bots, bigger suns, UFOs. Show the objectives top-left as one line each ("Planets 1 / 3"), plus score. Completing all objectives wins the level with a reward screen (coins, stars), a NEXT button, and a win sound; failing shows a fail screen with RETRY and a fail sound.

prompt: A game about a fox who collects berries in a forest.
playerMessage:
Berry Fox Run is a game where you guide a fox running down a forest path, switching between three lanes to dodge logs, rocks, stumps, and bushes. Collect berries along the way, since they come in arcs over obstacles or in short rows between them. Your score grows with distance and every berry you grab, and the game speeds up the longer you survive.

**Controls:** On a computer, use the arrow keys or A and D to change lanes and Space to jump (tap Space briefly for a short hop). On a phone, swipe left or right to switch lanes and tap to jump. Tap anywhere to start or play again.

prompt: A game about a fox who collects berries in a forest.
playerMessage:
Berry Fox is a calm, cozy matching game. A little fox sits in a sunny pine forest, filling its basket with strawberries, blueberries, raspberries, gooseberries, and grapes. Swap two neighboring berries to line up three or more, and watch them pop while new ones tumble in. Later rounds ask you to collect one kind of berry, and a fifth kind joins the forest in round 3. There are no timers or move limits, and if you get stuck, try the Hint or Shuffle buttons.

On a phone, tap a berry and then a neighbor, or swipe. On a computer, use the arrow keys or WASD to move, Space to pick, and an arrow to swap, or simply click.
